Test Case 1 is a baseline scenario for the EU-28 in 2007-2013 and Test Case 2 a policy scenario with the CAPRI reform measures implemented for the same period.

the baseline scenario is the most likely scenario for the future development of EU agricultural sector and its impact on the environment, while the policy scenario represents the most likely future policy scenario, which would be implemented in the EU in the near future.
the baseline and policy scenarios are constructed in a transparent and consistent manner and can be used to test and validate the integrated framework.

the SEAMLESS-If project will be able to provide an integrated framework that will be able to simulate and evaluate the impacts of agricultural policies and other drivers on the environment, food security and economic welfare.

this is the first time that a set of scenarios is developed for the European agriculture sector that is based on a comprehensive set of indicators that are used for the evaluation of policy impacts on the sector.

the SEAMLESS- IF framework can be successfully used for the assessment of policy measures.
